description:
“I want to be threatened, to have my money stolen, and to be rolled over.” A contractual relationship that started with a strange word...! Kim Joo-in, 27 years old. Neat and intelligent Korean language teacher. Son Young-woo, 32 years old. Former idol singer. (Now full-time as an actor, not very popular.) Two people with opposite personalities and temperament. Can you find perfect love in this relationship of being a teacher and a celebrity by day, and a master and slave by night...?

**Original Webtoon:**  
-R19: [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=160299), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/120045465), [Bomtoon](https://bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/real_lv_D), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/real_love_dog_1), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=2640873), [Comico](https://www.comico.kr/comic/2646), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_reallove_wz), [Peanutoon](https://www.peanutoon.com/ko/comic/detail/3931)
